# Convergence Issues and Outliers

```{r}
#| label: conv-table
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(kableExtra)
library(dplyr)

# STUDY 1: convergence & outliers summary (APA Style - landscape with longtable)
create_apa_convergence_table_study1 <- function(results_df) {
  results_df %>%
    filter(Parameter == "eta1") %>%
    select(
      Condition,
      Method, 
      Model, 
      Distribution, 
      SampleSize, 
      Reliability,
      N_Converged_This_Method,
      Convergence_Rate_This_Method,
      N_After_Global_Convergence,
      N_Outliers_This_Method,
      Outlier_Rate_This_Method,
      N_After_Global_Outlier,
      N_Final
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Distribution = case_when(
        Distribution == "nonnormal" ~ "right-skewed",
        TRUE ~ Distribution
      ),
      Convergence_Rate_This_Method = round(Convergence_Rate_This_Method, 1),
      Outlier_Rate_This_Method = round(Outlier_Rate_This_Method, 1)
    ) %>%
    arrange(Condition, factor(Model, levels = c("Full", "Linear")), Method)
}

# table
conv_table_study1 <- create_apa_convergence_table_study1(results_study_1)

tab_caption_study1 <- "Convergence and Outlier Statistics (Simulation 1)"
tab_note_study1 <- "N Conv. = number of replications that converged for this method. Conv. Rate = percentage of replications that converged (%). N Global Conv. = sample size after entire non-convergent iterations across approaches excluded. N Outliers = number of outliers detected for this method. Outlier Rate = percentage of converged cases flagged as outliers (%). N Global Outlier = sample size after global outlier removal across methods. N Final = final sample size after all exclusions."

kableExtra::kbl(
  conv_table_study1,
  booktabs = TRUE,
  longtable = TRUE,
  align = c("l", "l", "l", "l", "r", "r",
            "r", "r", "r",
            "r", "r",
            "r", "r"),
  col.names = c("Condition", "Method", "Model", "Distribution", "N", "Reliability",
                "N Conv.", "Conv. Rate", "N Global Conv.",
                "N Outliers", "Outlier Rate", "N Global Outlier", "N Final"),
  caption = tab_caption_study1,
  linesep = ""
) %>%
  kableExtra::add_header_above(c(
    " " = 6,
    "Convergence" = 3,
    "Outliers" = 2,
    "Final" = 2
  )) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("hold_position", "repeat_header", "scale_down"),
    font_size = 6,
    position = "left"
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top", latex_hline = "major") %>%
  kableExtra::footnote(
    general = tab_note_study1,
    general_title = "Note.",
    threeparttable = TRUE,
    escape = TRUE
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::landscape()


# STUDY 2: convergence & outliers summary (APA Style - landscape with longtable)
create_apa_convergence_table_study2 <- function(results_df, equation = "eta4") {
  param <- ifelse(equation == "eta4", "eta1", "eta4")
  
  results_df$results %>%
    filter(Equation == equation, Parameter == param) %>%
    select(
      Condition,
      Method, 
      Model, 
      Distribution, 
      SampleSize, 
      Reliability,
      N_Converged_This_Method,
      Convergence_Rate_This_Method,
      N_After_Global_Convergence,
      N_Outliers_This_Method,
      Outlier_Rate_This_Method,
      N_After_Global_Outlier,
      N_Final
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Distribution = case_when(
        Distribution == "nonnormal" ~ "right-skewed",
        TRUE ~ Distribution
      ),
      Convergence_Rate_This_Method = round(Convergence_Rate_This_Method, 1),
      Outlier_Rate_This_Method = round(Outlier_Rate_This_Method, 1)
    ) %>%
    arrange(Condition, factor(Model, levels = c("Full", "Linear")), Method)
}


# STUDY 2 - EQUATION ETA4 TABLE (because it is general; eta5 would be the same)
conv_table_study2_eta4 <- create_apa_convergence_table_study2(results_study_2, "eta4")

tab_caption_study2_eta4 <- "Convergence and Outlier Statistics (Simulation 2)"
tab_note_study2 <- "N Conv. = number of replications that converged for this method. Conv. Rate = percentage of replications that converged (%). N Global Conv. = sample size after requiring all methods to converge. N Outliers = number of outliers detected for this method. Outlier Rate = percentage of converged cases flagged as outliers (%). N Global Outlier = sample size after global outlier removal across methods. N Final = final sample size after all exclusions."

kableExtra::kbl(
  conv_table_study2_eta4,
  booktabs = TRUE,
  longtable = TRUE,
  align = c("l", "l", "l", "l", "r", "r",
            "r", "r", "r",
            "r", "r",
            "r", "r"),
  col.names = c("Condition", "Method", "Model", "Distribution", "N", "Reliability",
                "N Conv.", "Conv. Rate", "N Global Conv.",
                "N Outliers", "Outlier Rate", "N Global Outlier", "N Final"),
  caption = tab_caption_study2_eta4,
  linesep = ""
) %>%
  kableExtra::add_header_above(c(
    " " = 6,
    "Convergence" = 3,
    "Outliers" = 2,
    "Final" = 2
  )) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("hold_position", "repeat_header", "scale_down"),
    font_size = 6,
    position = "left"
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top", latex_hline = "major") %>%
  kableExtra::footnote(
    general = tab_note_study2,
    general_title = "Note.",

    escape = TRUE
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::landscape()
```
